## Notes

MicroProse, September 1991; Sid Meier and Bruce Shelley. MS-DOS, Amiga, Atari ST, PC-98, Windows, Macintosh, SNES, PlayStation, Saturn. Turn-based 4X from 4000 BC to AD 2100 against two to seven AI civs; one advance researched at a time; one-per-world wonders; barbarians; conquest or space-race victory. Influences: Tresham's Civilization board game, Empire, SimCity, Railroad Tycoon, Populous.
